title: M5Stack StampFly · K138
summary: ESP32-S3四旋翼开发平台，StampS3、四个空心杯马达、IMU、ToF和气压计；本平台仅外观展示，不模拟飞行。

facts.label: SoC
facts.value: ESP32-S3 @ Xtensa® 32-bit LX7 dual-core processor, clock frequency 240MHz

facts.label: Unscaled published visual model envelope
facts.method: Native STL coordinates, rigid X=-sourceX/Y=sourceZ/Z=sourceY; includes inset paper carrier 0.028 mm above StampS3 cover.
facts.notes: Linked simulator assembly, not manufacturer production CAD. Width/height exceed official 81.5 mm by 0.342 mm; depth exceeds 31 mm by 0.528 mm. No scale correction.

facts.label: Visible blades per rotor
facts.method: Counted four visible blades on each rotor in independent official top and bottom photographs.
facts.uncertainty: Blade count is clear; precise pitch and thickness cannot be established from these views.

facts.label: Exposed carrier PCB appearance
facts.value: Black carrier board, separately masked official front/back photographs on native source planes; photo-estimated optical daughterboard has UNKNOWN on its hidden inward face, plus a readable rear-carrier annotation for unknown internal layout.
facts.method: Front260×372pixel crop and back286×397rectification from800×800official photos; source topZ5.752mm and undersideZ4.252mm remain unscaled. Optical board13.2×21.6mm atZ-7.97 is photograph-estimated.
facts.uncertainty: Uncalibrated photo colors, remaining lens/height error; optical board seating uncertainty±1.5mm. Texture is exterior appearance, not reconstructed electronics.

facts.label: Carrier S1 USER_A shares module G0
facts.notes: Main schematic S1 connects USER_A to GND; P2.3 connects USER_A to Stamp G0. The photo-aligned carrier cap shares control button with the StampS3 cover.
